business_summary: IFE Elevators Co., Ltd. engages in the design, research, manufacturing, sale of elevators, escalators, moving walkways, and related products in China and internationally. The company offers passenger elevators, such as machine room and roomless passenger, panoramic, high speed, hospital, and firefighter; freight elevators, including machine room and roomless freight elevators, and high-speed freight elevators; and escalators comprising commercial, public transport, and heavy-duty public transport. It also provides moving walks consisting of inclined moving walks and horizontal moving walks; and hospital bed elevators, sightseeing elevators, home elevators, dumbwaiters, and explosion-proof elevators. The company was formerly known as Dongguan IFE Elevators Co., Ltd. and changed its name to IFE Elevators Co.,LTD. in 2011. IFE Elevators Co.,LTD. was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Dongguan, China.
